seo.title: Our Story
seo.description: Founded in 2015, Legendary is an artisanal Malaysian perfume house capturing the botanical heritage and soul of Malaysia through modern, world class perfumery.

header.title: The Legend of Scent
header.intro: Founded in 2015, Legendary is an artisanal Malaysian perfume house dedicated to capturing the rich botanical heritage and soulful essence of Malaysia through modern, world class perfumery.

beginning.heading: It started with a single flower
beginning.body:
Legendary began with Orchid, a signature scent born from the wild blooms of Malaysia’s ancient rainforests. Embodying a timeless balance of grace and serenity, it remains the eternal soul of the house.

Rooted in heritage yet crafted for the modern world, each Legendary creation is an authentic expression of art and emotion. We believe the right fragrance does more than linger. It awakens confidence, captures memories and leaves an unforgettable impression.

items.label: Our Vision
items.title: To carry the scent of Malaysia to the world
items.body: To be the fragrance house the world recognises as Malaysia’s own, proving that a scent born of this country’s landscapes, culture and craft belongs on any dressing table, anywhere.

items.label: Our Mission
items.title: Luxury that stays welcoming
items.body: To compose Malaysian fragrances of genuine quality at a price that invites people in rather than shutting them out. Made in authenticity, worn with pride, and served with complimentary samples, wrapping and delivery on every order.

items.title: Heritage
items.body: Every scent is a memory of Malaysia: its landscapes, its culture, its soul.

items.title: Craft
items.body: Composed in three considered acts: a first impression, a character, a memory.

items.title: Integrity
items.body: Made to the same standard every time, so you can wear it with confidence and pride.

items.title: Generosity
items.body: Complimentary samples, wrapping and delivery, because luxury should feel welcoming.
